scope: Apple/macOS open-source implementation references used to validate command and subsystem terminology in this project.

facts.statement: Apple describes XNU as the kernel of Darwin used by macOS and iOS; its source tree combines Mach, BSD components, and IOKit-related code.
Apple's launchd source and launchctl manual document launchctl as the interface to launchd and identify LaunchAgents and LaunchDaemons as macOS job domains.

Apple's distribution-macOS repository enumerates released open-source components including IOKit families, DiskArbitration, Libc, Libsystem, dyld, PowerManagement, Security, and system configuration components.
Apple's system_cmds repository contains Darwin/macOS command sources including nvram and sysctl, which are directly relevant to this project's NVRAM and kernel-parameter collectors.

Apple's distribution-macOS manifest includes IOKitUser, IOKitTools, IOGraphics, IONetworkingFamily, IOPCIFamily and IOStorageFamily, supporting the project's use of IORegistry/IOKit-derived hardware evidence.
